name: tellclip
description: Tellclip workflows for agents: a demo-recording skill and hosted MCP for shared clips. Local recording uses the separately installed Tellclip CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Record demos and work with shared clips
interface.longDescription: Record polished product demos from macOS, then find, review, organize, and comment on shared Tellclip clips.
defaultPrompt: Record and share a product demo with Tellclip
Summarize feedback on my latest Tellclip clip
Find a Tellclip clip and get its transcript
